steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I knew you would make this choice.
You reach for them, and in that gesture, the crimson shackles slip from your form, moving toward the three sisters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This should be the last hurdle on your way home.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But if I can help it, I'd rather you didn't have to face this risk alone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So... if you're willing to trust me, let me use my shackles to connect myself, the three of you, and this painting.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can use that new bond to clear the path home.
In silence, the sisters respond. One hand, then another, then a third—they rest their palms upon your own.
With a firm grip, you hold them and unleash the shackles.
A flash of crimson light erupts, and barbed tendrils of energy instantly coil around the sisters.
In that same moment, the rift exerts a violent, familiar pull—the same force that once tore the sisters from their world—and yanks all four of you into its churning void.
